verses.ar: أَلَا يَا اللَّهُ بِنَظْرَةْ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ الرَّحِيمَةْ ۞ تُدَاوِي كُلَّ مَا بِي مِنْ أَمْرَاضٍ سَقِيمَةْ
verses.tr: Alā yā Allāhu bi-naẓrah mina l-ʿayni r-raḥīmah, tudāwī kulla mā bī min amrāḍin saqīmah.
verses.en: O Allah, with a glance from Your Merciful Eye, heal all the ailments and sicknesses within me.

verses.ar: أَلَا يَا صَاحْ يَا صَاحْ لَا تَجْزَعْ وَتَضْجَرْ ۞ وَسَلِّمْ لِلْمَقَادِيرْ كَي تُحْمَدْ وَتُؤْجَرْ
verses.tr: Alā yā ṣāḥ yā ṣāḥ lā tajzaʿ wa-taḍjar, wa-sallim li-l-maqādīr kay tuḥmad wa-tu'jar.
verses.en: O friend, O friend, do not despair or grow restless, submit to what is decreed, so you may be praised and rewarded.

verses.ar: وَكُنْ رَاضِي بِمَا قَدَّرَ الْمَوْلَى وَدَبَّرْ ۞ وَلَا تَسْخَطْ قَضَا اللَّهْ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْأَكْبَرْ
verses.tr: Wa-kun rāḍī bimā qaddara l-mawlā wa-dabbar, wa-lā taskhaṭ qaḍā Llāh Rabbi l-ʿarshi l-akbar.
verses.en: Be content with what the Master has decreed and arranged, and do not resent the judgment of Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne.

verses.ar: وَكُنْ صَابِرْ وَشَاكِرْ ۞ تَكُنْ فَائِزْ وَظَافِرْ ۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ السَّرَائِرْ
verses.tr: Wa-kun ṣābir wa-shākir, takun fā'iz wa-ẓāfir, wa-min ahli s-sarā'ir.
verses.en: Be patient and grateful, and you will be victorious and triumphant, among the people of inward purity.

verses.ar: رِجَالُ اللهِ مِنْ كُلِّ ذِي قَلْبٍ مُنَوَّرْ ۞ مُصَفَّى مِنْ جَمِيعِ الدَّنَسْ طَيِّبْ مُطَهَّرْ
verses.tr: Rijālu Llāhi min kulli dhī qalbin munawwar, muṣaffā min jamīʿi d-danas ṭayyib muṭahhar.
verses.en: The Men of Allah are all those whose hearts are illuminated, purified from every stain, wholesome and pure.

verses.ar: وَذِهْ دُنْيَا دَنِيَّهْ حَوَادِثْهَا كَثِيرَهْ ۞ وَعِيشَتْهَا حَقِيرَهْ وَمُدَّتْهَا قَصِيرَهْ
verses.tr: Wa-dhih dunyā danīyah ḥawādithhā kathīrah, wa-ʿīshathā ḥaqīrah wa-muddathā qaṣīrah.
verses.en: This lowly world is full of calamities, life therein is insignificant, its span is short.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحْرِصْ عَلَيْهَا سِوَى أَعْمَى الْبَصِيرَهْ ۞ عَدِيمِ الْعَقْلِ لَوْ كَانَ يَعْقِلْ كَانَ أَفْكَرْ
verses.tr: Wa-lā yaḥriṣ ʿalayhā siwā aʿmā l-baṣīrah, ʿadīmi l-ʿaqli law kāna yaʿqil kāna afkar.
verses.en: No one covets it except one blind of insight, devoid of reason, if he possessed understanding, he would reflect [over the lowliness of the world].

verses.ar: يُفَكِّرْ فِي فَنَاهَا ۞ وَفِي كَثْرَةْ عَنَاهَا ۞ وَفِي قِلَّةْ غِنَاهَا
verses.tr: Yufakkir fī fanāhā, wa-fī kathrat ʿanāhā, wa-fī qillat ghināhā.
verses.en: Reflect on its passing away, on the abundance of its troubles, and on the meagreness of its wealth.

verses.ar: فَطُوبَى ثُمَّ طُوبَى لِمَنْ مِنْهَا تَحَذَّرْ ۞ وَطَلَّقَهَا وَفِي طَاعَةِ الرَّحْمٰنِ شَمَّرْ
verses.tr: Fa-ṭūbā thumma ṭūbā liman minhā taḥadhdhar, wa-ṭallaqahā wa-fī ṭāʿati r-Raḥmāni shammar.
verses.en: So glad tidings, then yet more glad tidings, to the one who takes heed of it, who divorces it, and strives in obedience to the Most Merciful.

verses.ar: أَلَا يَا عَيْنِ جُودِي بِدَمْعٍ مِنْكِ سَائِلْ ۞ عَلَى ذَاكَ الْحَبِيبِ الَّذِي قَدْ كَانَ نَازِلْ
verses.tr: Alā yā ʿayni jūdī bi-damʿin minki sā'il, ʿalā dhāka l-ḥabībi lladhī qad kāna nāzil.
verses.en: O my eye, weep with flowing tears, for that Beloved who once dwelled among us.

verses.ar: مَعَانَا فِي الْمَرَابِعِ وَأَصْبَحَ سَفَرْ رَاحِلْ ۞ وَأَمْسَى الْقَلْبُ وَالْبَالْ مِنْ بُعْدِهْ مُكَدَّرْ
verses.tr: Maʿānā fī l-marābiʿi wa-aṣbaḥa safar rāḥil, wa-amsā l-qalbu wa-l-bāl min buʿdih mukaddar.
verses.en: Who once dwelt among us in those blessed meadows, but whose caravan has now departed, now the heart and mind are clouded by his absence.

verses.ar: وَلَكِنْ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهْ ۞ وَكُلُّ الْأَمْرِ لِلَّهْ ۞ وَلَا يَبْقَى سِوَى اللَّهْ
verses.tr: Wa-lākin ḥasbīya Llāh, wa-kullu l-amri li-Llāh, wa-lā yabqā siwā Llāh.
verses.en: Yet Allah is sufficient for me, all affairs belong to Allah, and none remains but Allah.

verses.ar: عَلَى بَشَارِ جَادَتْ سَحَائِبْ رَحْمَةِ الْبَرْ ۞ وَحَيَّاهُمْ بِرَوْحِ الرِّضَى رَبِّي وَبَشَّرْ
verses.tr: ʿAlā Bashāri jādat saḥā'ib raḥmati l-bar, wa-ḥayyāhum bi-rawḥi r-riḍā Rabbī wa-bashshar.
verses.en: Upon Bashar poured the clouds of the grace of the Most Kind, and my Lord greeted them with the breeze of His pleasure and glad tidings.

verses.ar: بِهَا سَادَاتُنَا وَالشُّيُوخُ الْعَارِفُونَا ۞ وَأَهْلُونَا وَأَحْبَابْ قَلْبِي نَازِلُونَا
verses.tr: Bihā sādatunā wa-sh-shuyūkhu l-ʿārifūnā, wa-ahlūnā wa-aḥbāb qalbī nāzilūnā.
verses.en: Therein dwell our scholarly masters and the lordly gnostics, and our families and beloved ones.

verses.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ فِي سَرَائِرْ فُؤَادِي قَاطِنُونَا ۞ بِسَاحَهْ تُرْبِهَا مِنْ ذَكِيِّ الْمِسْكِ أَعْطَرَ
verses.tr: Wa-minhum fī sarā'ir fu'ādī qāṭinūnā, bi-sāḥah turbihā min dhakiyyi l-miski aʿṭar.
verses.en: Some of them reside in the depths of my heart, in a courtyard whose soil is more fragrant than pure musk.

verses.ar: مَنَازِلُ خَيْرِ سَادَهْ ۞ لِكُلِّ النَّاسِ قَادَهْ ۞ مَحَبَّتُهُمْ سَعَادَه
verses.tr: Manāzilu khayri sādah, li-kulli n-nāsi qādah, maḥabbatuhum saʿādah.
verses.en: The dwellings of the noblest masters, guides for all people, loving them is felicity.

verses.ar: أَلَا يَا بَخْتِ مَنْ زَارَهُمْ بِالصِّدْقِ وَانْذَرْ ۞ إِلَيْهِمْ مُعْتَنِي كُلُّ مَطْلُوبُهْ تَيَسَّرْ
verses.tr: Alā yā bakhti man zārahum bi-ṣ-ṣidqi wa-ndhar, ilayhim muʿtanī kullu maṭlūbuh tayassar.
verses.en: How fortunate is the one who visits them with sincerity and reverent awe, for to such a seeker, all that he desires is made easy.
